summary_en: Media Corp tender offer for Oricon Inc. closed July 14, 2006. Tender applicants submitted 4,101,180 shares, exceeding the minimum threshold of 1,074,100 shares. Settlement began July 11, 2006. Upon settlement completion, Media Corp's voting stake will reach 90% or more, making it a major shareholder and resulting in Oricon's delisting and privatization as Media Corp's wholly owned subsidiary.
title_en: Notice regarding results of public tender offer for shares of Oricon Inc. by Media Corp and changes in major shareholders and related companies
translation_en_brief: Media Corp's public tender offer for Oricon Inc. ordinary shares closed on July 14, 2006. The offer, which began May 19, 2006, received applications for 4,101,180 shares, exceeding the stated minimum threshold of 1,074,100 shares. The offer therefore succeeded in full. Settlement commenced July 11, 2006. Upon completion of settlement, Media Corp will hold voting rights representing 90% or more of total shareholder voting rights, qualifying it as a major shareholder. The transaction results in Oricon's privatization and conversion to a wholly owned subsidiary of Media Corp, which is itself wholly owned by Techno Logic Co. The chairman of Oricon's board, Tsuneo Koike, holds 71,700 Oricon shares and will indirectly reinvest through his asset management company following Media Corp's acquisition of full control.
